note: Machine-readable form of the open findings in the first-pass review. The gate reads this file itself: store.publish has no argument that can omit it, and a register that cannot be read holds every candidate. A finding holds the record it names and any record citing the same page, even when a validation report claims support, so an unresolved discrepancy cannot be published away. An entry is removed only when the finding was corrected and the corrected claim was re-checked against a retained snapshot in content/snapshots.
